newsitem.title: USA: FFO director has Republic debentures.
newsitem.headline: FFO director has Republic debentures.

text.p: William Hough, a director of FFO Financial Group Inc, said Tuesday he, his wife and an affiliated corporation purchased $300,000 worth of convertible debentures of Republic Bancshares Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Hough said the debentures were purchased on December 27 and are convertible into common stock at $17.85714 a share.
Hough said there are no plans to convert the debentures, acquire additional securities or sell securities of Republic.

Hough said the debentures are convertible into 16,800 common shares. Together with an additional 2,316,906 in common stock equivalents, including options and preferred shares, held by him, his wife and affiliates, the group holds 2,333,706 in equivalent common stock, he said.
